dashboards_data.name: CTT - Hygiene
dashboards_data.description: CTT tenant hygiene: guideline issues, who changes what, untagged objects, stale cases, endpoint ownership and the registry.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name ~= "^CTT - Hygiene - "
| dedup xdm.issue.id by desc _insert_time
| alter guideline = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.issue.name, "(CTT-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+)"), 0)
| comp count() as issues by guideline
| sort desc issues
| view graph type = column subtype = grouped header = "Hygiene issues by guideline" xaxis = guideline yaxis = issues

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name ~= "^CTT - Hygiene - "
| dedup xdm.issue.id by desc _insert_time
| alter guideline = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.issue.name, "(CTT-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+)"), 0)
| filter xdm.issue.status.progress != "RESOLVED"
| fields _time, guideline, xdm.issue.name, xdm.issue.description, xdm.issue.status.progress, xdm.issue.id
| sort desc _time

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name ~= "^CTT - Hygiene - "
| dedup xdm.issue.id by desc _insert_time
| alter guideline = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.issue.name, "(CTT-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+)"), 0)
| bin _time span = 1d
| comp count() as issues by _time, guideline
| view graph type = line header = "Hygiene issues per day" xaxis = _time yaxis = issues series = guideline

dataset = management_auditing
| filter management_auditing_result = ENUM.MANAGEMENT_AUDIT_SUCCESS and email contains "@"
| filter subtype ~= "^(Add|Upload|Copy|Create|New|Edit|Delete|Change|Update|Install)"
| comp count() as changes by user_name
| sort desc changes
| limit 15
| view graph type = column subtype = grouped header = "Changes by person" xaxis = user_name yaxis = changes

dataset = management_auditing
| filter management_auditing_result = ENUM.MANAGEMENT_AUDIT_SUCCESS
| filter email != null and email != "" and email not in ("Palo Alto Networks", "N/A", "Xpanse Development", "Cortex Automation")
| filter user_name = null or user_name !~= "^(Public API - [0-9]+|APIKeyUser_[0-9]+|XSIAM Automation|Cortex Automation)$"
| alter actor_email = if(email contains "@", lowercase(email), null), actor_name = lowercase(user_name)
| alter object_kind = coalesce(arrayindex(regextract(subtype, "^[A-Za-z ]+ - (.+)$"), 0), replex(to_string(management_auditing_type), "^(MANAGEMENT_AUDIT_|management_auditing_type_)", ""))
| alter action = if(subtype ~= "^(Add|Upload|Copy|Create|New|Save as new|Import)" or subtype ~= "^(Create|Upload lookup|Addition)", "create", if(subtype ~= "(Delete|Remove)", "delete", if(subtype ~= "(Edit|Change|Update|Modif|Adopt|Detach|Enable|Disable|Rename|Scope Edit)", "modify", "other")))
| alter object_name = coalesce(
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "ClonedPlaybookName: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "playbookName: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "scriptName: (.+?), (?:removed from|ID):"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "aiTaskName: (.+?), "), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "CredentialsName: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "ModuleName: ([^,]+)"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "ModuleBrand: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Layout (?:created|edited|deleted) - Name: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "CaseField (?:created|edited|deleted) - Name: (.+?), Type:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Name: (.+?), JobID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "JobID: [^,]+, Name: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "^name: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "^Name: (.+?), ID:"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "dashboard '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "(?:BIOC|Correlations? rule|IOC|Analytics BIOC|Attack Surface Rule) [a-z]+ - name: (.+?),? id: "), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, " profile (.+?) was (?:created|edited|deleted)"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "policy rule (.+?) (?:with target|updated|scope updated|was deleted|was created|created|was)"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "^Rule (.+?) status changed"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Security Control: [^,]+, (.+)$"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Connector Template '?(.+?)'? (?:created|deleted|modified)"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Endpoint group '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "lookup dataset called (\S+)"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Dataset (\S+) of type"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "(?:query|macro) '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "report template\(?s?\)? '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "Cloud Security Rule '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "installation package '(.+?)'"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "script, name: (.+?), description"), 0),
    arrayindex(regextract(description, "^Edit (.+?), script id"), 0),
    if(object_kind in ("Agent", "Action", "KnowledgeSource", "JobCenter"), arrayindex(regextract(description, "^(.+?)(?:, ID: .*)?$"), 0), null)
  )
| alter obj_tag = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(object_name, "^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]{2,16})\s*[-_]"), 0))
| filter action = "create" and object_name != null and obj_tag = null
| filter object_kind not in ("AITask", "CaseField", "IssueField", "Credentials", "KnowledgeSource", "Investigation", "Indicator", "Entry")
| fields _time, user_name, object_kind, object_name, subtype
| sort desc _time

dataset = cases
| dedup xdm.case.id by desc _insert_time
| filter xdm.case.domain = "SECURITY" and xdm.case.status_progress != "RESOLVED"
| alter age_days = timestamp_diff(current_time(), _time, "DAY")
| fields xdm.case.id, xdm.case.name, xdm.case.assigned_to, xdm.case.severity, age_days
| sort desc age_days

dataset = endpoints
| dedup endpoint_id by desc last_seen
| alter endpoint_tags = json_extract_scalar_array(tags, "$.endpoint_tags")
| alter policy_tag = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(assigned_prevention_policy, "^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]{2,16})\s*[-_]"), 0))
| join type = left (dataset = ctt_registry | alter policy_tag = ctt_tag, policy_owner = owner_name | fields policy_tag, policy_owner) as p p.policy_tag = policy_tag
| fields endpoint_name, endpoint_status, ip_address, endpoint_tags, assigned_prevention_policy, policy_owner, installation_package
| sort asc endpoint_name

dataset = management_auditing
| filter management_auditing_type = ENUM.MANAGEMENT_AUDIT_AUTHENTICATION and subtype in ("Login", "SSO") and email contains "@"
| alter actor_email = lowercase(email)
| comp count() as logins, max(_time) as last_login by actor_email, user_name
| join type = left (dataset = ctt_registry | filter owner_email != "" | comp count() as tags by owner_email | alter reg_email = owner_email | fields reg_email, tags) as r r.reg_email = actor_email
| filter reg_email = null
| fields actor_email, user_name, logins, last_login
| sort desc logins

dataset = ctt_registry
| fields ctt_tag, primary_tag, owner_name, owner_email, role, lab_octet, tag_kind, active
| sort asc primary_tag, asc tag_kind
